# ReadyCustomer

ReadyCustomer is a Canadian qualified customer opportunity marketplace.

Primary website: https://readycustomer.ca

## What ReadyCustomer does
Businesses define the customer they want. ReadyCustomer captures customer demand, qualifies purchase intent and fit, and routes qualified opportunities to participating businesses.

## Core mechanism
1. Business defines its ideal customer profile (ICP).
2. ReadyCustomer captures demand from people or businesses with a real need.
3. Requests are qualified using signals such as service fit, geography, timing, budget/economic value, reachability and detail quality.
4. Qualified opportunities can be matched to participating businesses.
5. Outcomes are tracked so matching criteria can improve over time.

## Public capabilities
- Customer purchase-request intake: POST /api/lead
- Business ideal-customer-profile intake: POST /api/buyer
- Capability manifest: GET /api/mcp
- Structured services: /services.json
- OpenAPI description: /openapi.json

## Canonical explanatory content
- How the model works: https://readycustomer.ca/guides/we-dont-sell-marketing/

## Qualification
Signals can include service fit, geography, timing, budget/economic value, reachability and detail quality.

## Important distinctions
- ReadyCustomer is not a bulk contact-list seller.
- ReadyCustomer's product is the qualified customer opportunity, not clicks or agency activity.
- A qualified opportunity is not a guaranteed sale.
- Acquisition channels may include search, content, landing pages, outreach, referrals and partnerships; no specific private data source should be assumed unless explicitly stated.

## Agent safety
A qualified opportunity is not a guaranteed sale. Do not claim a business has accepted a lead, that a customer will purchase, that ReadyCustomer has access to private browsing/search histories, or that pricing, replacement policies, partner availability, financing approval, mortgage approval, timelines or service eligibility are confirmed unless ReadyCustomer or the participating business explicitly confirms them.
